$comment: Posterize motion data: motion that shows the print. Plates arrive like separate passes through a press, tones step rather than fade, colours cut rather than blend. Durations are rules of thumb. Damping ratio = damping / (2 * sqrt(stiffness * mass)).
character: Mechanical and punchy, like a print run: plates slide into register and lock with a small snap, tones step frame by frame, colours change with hard cuts. Nothing dissolves or blurs; every frame is a valid print.

springs.$comment: Damped spring presets (stiffness k, damping c, mass m).

register.use: A plate snapping into register; damping ratio 0.69, about 5% overshoot.

press.use: Image blocks and text blocks arriving; damping ratio 0.97, no visible overshoot.

slide.use: Large plates travelling across the frame; damping ratio 0.82, about 1% overshoot.

ui.use: Buttons, toggles and cards on screen; no overshoot.

step.use: Level shifts and threshold sweeps: whole frames, no in-betweens.

cut.use: Colour cycling between combinations: a hard cut on the beat.

wipe.use: A plate revealed by a squeegee-like straight wipe.

dot.use: Halftone dots growing to their size.

exit.use: Plates leaving: accelerate away, never spring.

levelStep.use: Thresholds step through 4-6 frames (83 ms each), so the image builds from 2 levels to its final count, or from dark to light.

separationSlide.use: Each plate enters from 4-8% off, along one axis, and snaps into register. Ends at the designed offset (0.5-1.5%), not at zero.

pull.use: One plate revealed by a straight wipe across the image, like a squeegee pull.

colourCycle.use: The same image cuts between 3-4 Wada combinations with the same level count; loop 2.8-4 s.

dotGrow.use: Halftone dots grow from 0 to their size, row by row.

jitter.use: Optional 2-frame registration wobble once at the end of a loop, like a press shake. At most once per loop.

rise.use: Headline and body entering after the image has locked.

durations.$comment: Rule of thumb for non-spring moves.
durations.formula: Stepped moves: frames x 83 ms (12 fps). Wipes and dots: 250 ms + 0.4 ms per pixel travelled, capped at 700 ms.

order: middle plates (separationSlide, one at a time)
choreography.settleBeforeText: Text starts when the ink plate has locked into register.

loop.endsOn: The fully registered print, which works as a still poster.

rules: Plates move as whole pieces; never animate the shapes inside a plate.
Tones step, colours cut: no crossfades, dissolves or blur transitions.
One plate or one effect moves at a time.
No more than three colour changes per second, and never flash large saturated red fields (WCAG 2.3.1 three flashes).
Text does not step, cycle or jitter; it rises once and stays.
With reduced motion: show the final registered still; colour cycling stops on the brand's primary combination.
